_comment: Copy to scripts/live-test.config.json (gitignored) and fill in.
The live test runs against a RUNNING dev deployment. It creates throwaway
KBs, ingests documents into them, asks questions, then deletes them again.
Never point it at anything you care about.
base_url        the frontend proxy, so middleware auth is exercised too
bearer_token    APP_PASSWORD or ADMIN_PASSWORD from frontend/.env
pgvector        needed only to CREATE a pgvector test KB — the connection
string is a field of the KB config, posted to the API. The
test never opens a database connection itself. Since the KB
API masks stored secrets it cannot be read back, so put it
here. Set enabled=false to skip the pgvector pass entirely.
